name: MINOX
recent: MINOX 近期有多项企业提案公告，以及董事在公开市场的交易和闭市期交易意向。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度的业绩。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 10 月 15 日公告多项提案 (MULTIPLE PROPOSALS)。
独立非执行董事 Ng Kuan Hua 于 2026 年 9 月 18 日以每股 RM0.155 收购 22,200 股普通股。
董事经理 Cheong Chee Son 于 2026 年 11 月 17 日公告在闭市期有交易意向。
risks: 董事经理 Cheong Chee Son 在闭市期有交易意向，可能涉及股权变动。

recent_en: MINOX recently announced multiple proposals and had director dealings in the open market as well as an intention to deal during the closed period. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: The company announced multiple proposals on 15 October 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Director Ng Kuan Hua acquired 22,200 ordinary shares at RM0.155 per share on 18 September 2026.
Managing Director Cheong Chee Son announced an intention to deal during the closed period on 17 November 2026.
risks_en: Managing Director Cheong Chee Son has an intention to deal during the closed period, which may involve a change in shareholding.
